notes.title: Patch 1.1 - March 13
notes.notes:
Korean Translation
Thanks to MG2000, Break the Loop is now available in Korean! Many thanks to him for all his hard work. 

Balancing 
We've received a lot of feedback about the difficulty of Cataclysm mode. In addition to new mechanics to learn, enemies were gaining too many stats, so we're lowering Monster Power and Hit Points by 10% in Cataclysm modes 1, 2 and 3.

Elisen: 
Fluid Combustion: skill cost reduced from 45 to 40 energy.
Incendiary Blade: direct damage increased by 10%.

Modjo: 
Marking territory: energy gain increases from 20 to 25 (and 4 charges instead of 5).

Hellmut: 
Crimson cascade: skill cost reduced from 70 to 65 energy.

Zoe: 
House smoke: skill cost drops from 60 to 55 energy.
The Soporific Gas now inflic damage.

Carmenide: 
Echo of chaos: direct damage increased by 10%.

Pepperbeard: 
One for the road: skill cost reduced from 50 to 45 energy.

Bugs: 

The game will no longer crash when you obtain passives by killing the second boss when you already had all your passives.

Tooltips:

We've corrected or improved several tooltips to make it easier to understand the game's various mechanics (thanks to Lûte the Goblin).

Capsule Armored
Capsule Favorite
Double Agent capsule
Capsule Battering Ram
Superior Distributor
Contamination (Golem's passiv)

notes.title: Patch 1.0.11 - September 09
notes.notes:
Bugs
Fixed a bug with text tips during loading screens
Fixed a display bug in the credits
Fixed a bug with the Condemned that could cause a crash (thanks to Foarte Mișto)

Reduced the damage and health points of all enemies by approximately 10% (for all difficulty levels). This should make the game and its 'endgame' more accessible.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.7 - June 20
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Today's patch includes a few bug fixes and a little balancing. Based on player feedback and the data we've gathered, we think Break the Loop is fairly well-balanced: normal mode is relatively manageable, and cataclysm mode offers an interesting challenge.

One last thing before the various patch modifications: if you haven't already done so and you'd like to support us, don't forget to leave a little steam review, it'd be a great help to us.

Bugs:
• Fixed a bug with Carmenide during the Alien Emperor battle.
• Fixed a bug that caused a crash when killing certain bosses with a Bomberman capsule bomb.

Balancing:
• The Brute and Glass Cannon capsules offer advantages in exchange for a slight penalty but are also the least appreciated in the game. To make them more appealing, we are reducing the penalties by 5% without affecting their bonuses.
• Yot: nerf of 15% damage to his Tongue attack.
• Pat & Pesto: the two zombie brothers are a bit too fast. Slightly increased the cost of their attacks.
• Alien Tank Boss: slight nerf of 10% to the damage of its rockets (passive ability).
• Cricket: Cricket’s health points reduced from 390 to 375 HP.

notes.notes:
Bugs:
Fixed a bug with the bear event where the game could crash when the bear came to help the heroes. (Thanks Artosor).
Fixed the negative Burn effect that could appear with the Bonfire capsule. (Thanks Skoflt).

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 - May 20
notes.notes:
Bugs:

 • Fixed a bug with the Opportunism capsule that caused a crash when it was disabled by the Corrupted Forge event (thanks to 初雪樱花).
 • Fixed a bug with the Midas capsule that could increase the healing of heroes when they were corrupted by Yot Soghoth (thanks to deee).

 • Corrected tooltips for capsules that affected healing without specifying it in the text.
 • Minor bug fixes to ensure game stability.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 - May 17
notes.notes:
Balancing:
Yot-Soghoth seems to be a bit too strong for a first major boss on normal difficulty. We are increasing the loss of corruption when a corrupted hero heals the boss. The encounter in Cataclysm remains unchanged.

Bugs:
Fixed a bug with Upery not transforming into a sheep.
Fixed a bug with the Colossus (boss 2 of the first biome) summoning a Locust with 0 HP.

Other:
When a hero is temporarily replaced, you can get a character that hasn't been unlocked yet.

notes.title: Break the Loop release date
notes.notes:
The Mastodonte team is pleased to announce that Break the Loop will be released on Steam on May 16th. The demo is currently available, feel free to test the game and wishlist it if you're interested!
